The Swarovski-studded Christmas crackers everyone is snapping up this holiday

Nothing reveals one's true irksome colours quite like a bon bon.
AuthorRachel Weisz
AuthorJess G. Lynch
October 30, 2026

Nothing reveals one’s true colours quite like a bon bon. Bon bons or Christmas crackers have long been an added source of contention at Christmas lunch – coaxing the most dogged quest for victory even out of Grandma Gwen.

So, if you think your nearest and dearest can handle the heat, why not forgo the flimsy key-rings and nail clippers, and raise the stakes with a box of luxury Christmas crackers?

From Swarovski-studded Christmas crackers to luxurious (and edible) chocolate surprises from Ferrero Rocher, read on for our curated edit of the best luxury Christmas crackers and bon bons for 2026 that will really stoke the fire of sibling rivalry this Yuletide.

You might also like A growing list of the best luxury Advent calendars of 2026 to spoil your loved ones

Our top picks for best luxury Christmas crackers

  • Best overall: Mestige Swarovski Christmas crackers, $65 at The Iconic
  • Best value: L’Occitane Haute-Provence crackers set of four, $55 at The Iconic
  • Best design: Country Road Merry bonbons, $59.95 at The Iconic
  • Best fragrance crackers: Jo Malone London cream cracker, $87 at Jo Malone London
  • Best food crackers: Ferrero Rocher chocolate Christmas cracker box, $15.66 at Amazon
  • Best traditional/decorative crackers: Star luxury handmade Christmas crackers, $62.95 $39.95 at Temple & Webster

A growing list of luxury Christmas crackers for the festive feast in 2026

01

Mestige sustainable Christmas crackers embellished with Swarovski crystals

$65 at The Iconic

According to our data, 90% of Gourmet Traveller readers of this article purchased the Mestige holographic prism luxury christmas crackers for their Christmas tablescape last year. With an inclusion of six luxury accessories embellished with crystals from Swarovski, it’s easy to see why.

Also available:

  • Gold colourway, $65
  • Silver colourway, $65
shop Now

02

L’Occitane Haute-Provence crackers set of four

$55 at The Iconic

Each cracker in the L’Occitane Haute-Provence set reveals a shower product paired with a matching hand cream to bring a little Provençal joy this holiday season.

shop Now

03

Jo Malone London cream cracker

$87 at Jo Malone London

Jo Malone’s iconic Christmas range takes the festive season to new heights. Featuring three iconic Jo Malone products in each cracker, infuse the festive season with one of these delights, especially if your skin is in need of some extra TLC.

Also available:

  • Silver colourway, $87
shop Now

04

Elizabeth Arden Party Ready two-piece cracker

$72 at Myer

Lush both inside and out, the Elizabeth Arden Party Ready Christmas cracker features the Flawless Start Instant Perfecting Primer and Grand Entrance Dramatic Volume, Length and Lift Mascara. It’s a delightful duo fit for a Christmas brunch-turned-energetic-soirée.

shop Now

05

Country Road Merry bonbons set of six

$59.95 at The Iconic

Country Road homewares are inspired by modern day Australian living, and their Bonbon range follows this design ethos. The set of six offers various gifts inside, and will look exquisite on any tablescape.

Also available:

  • Pink and green colourway, $59.95
  • Gold colourway, $59.95
shop Now

06

Palm Beach Collection bon bon room mist set of four

$64.95 at The Iconic

Strawberry fields and summer jasmine meet rich, velvety sandalwood in this four pack of luxurious, sweet scents — perfect for a summer tablescape.

Also available:

  • Cabana Cocktail, $64.95
  • Cedar Coast, $64.95
shop Now

07

Ferrero Rocher chocolate Christmas cracker box

$15.66 at Amazon

Individually wrapped for sharing, enjoy 10 delectable treats in a single box for a post-Christmas lunch delight.

shop Now

08

Glasshouse Fragrances Kyoto In Bloom Christmas bon bon set

$19.95 at Myer

This limited edition bon bon set features two personal fragrance miniatures that are an ode to spring, featuring a captivating floral fragrance.

shop Now

09

Ecoya French pear hand repair bon bon

$14.95 at Myer

Available in three scents, including Mandarin Gin and Guava & Lychee Sorbet, these festive hand creams will add a little bit of whimsicality to your festive tablescape. Plus your hands will thank you!

Also available:

  • Mandarin Gin, $14.95
  • Guava & Lychee Sorbet, $14.95
shop Now

10

Wella Professionals ultimate smooth travel trio

$67.95 $38.22 at Oz Hair & Beauty

Ensure the competitive spirits are high around the table with Wella Professionals deluxe travel trio, perfect for the luxury jet setter or beauty aficionado.

shop Now

11

Star luxury handmade Christmas crackers 8-pack

$62.95 $39.95 at Temple & Webster

For a more traditional approach, the bright stars of these handmade bon bons will surely help guide you to Christmas lunch.

shop Now

  • Champagne Sparkling Luxury Christmas Crackers (Set Of 8), $54.95 $39.95 at Temple & Webster
  • Wattle Christmas Crackers (Set of 8), $52.95 $39.95 at Temple & Webster
  • Tartan Christmas Bon Bons (Set Of 12), $10 at Big W

Author Rachel Weisz Shopping Content Producer

Rachel Weisz is the Shopping and Travel Writer at Gourmet Traveller, with over half a decade of experience covering everything from fashion and culture to travel. With bylines in Vogue, Vogue Living, InStyle Australia, Fashion Journal, Australian House & Garden, Belle and more, she now draws on her multidisciplinary background to shape her travel coverage. Rachel has an acute eye for trends that define the cultural zeitgeist, drawing on her expertise in editorial, e-commerce and social media to approach her work with a holistic perspective. When she’s not writing (a rare sight), she’s wandering through galleries, hunting down fashion archives or travelling to unique destinations she'll inevitably end up covering somewhere.

Linkedin Instagram
Author Jess G. Lynch Shopping Editor

Journalist and sometimes screenwriter Jess G. Lynch is a former Shopping Editor at Are Media who worked across some of Australia’s leading titles such as Gourmet Traveller, Home Beautiful, Better Homes & Gardens and Australian Women’s Weekly. With a Master of Arts in Creative Writing from UTS, and a Bachelor of Media from Macquarie University and the University of Bologna, Jess brings a rich blend of expertise to her work. Formerly, the vertical lead for travel, homes and lifestyle affiliate content across the publisher’s digital titles, she knows a thing or two about cultivating rich experiences both near and far from home. Based on Gadigal land, Jess is a regular at off-the-beaten track swim spots and inner west coffee haunts – often deep within a research spiral of destinations here and abroad. Her work has also appeared on titles such as marie claire, ELLE, news.com.au, Homes To Love, Who, body+soul, Kidspot, FBi Radio and in The Australian.
